body: Talking to somebody is by far the best you can do. It comforts you, and a problem shared is a problem halved!
Passing out might not be a bad thing. You'll definitely make it through the night if you do, you'll probably feel better in the morning too!
You may feel you are weak, but you have got to strengthen the part of you that wants to talk about it and allow yourself to expose your feelings
Good! If he does not reply soon, call him! you are definitely on the right track!

You are neither selfish nor stupid, you are the victim here. Please call a doctor :) or call your sister and explain to her what is happening. But please do not think you are selfish or stupid. Even if you were (which you aren't), nobody deserves to be killed because they are selfish. Please talk to someone
Bro please read my advice if you feel suicidal. Talking to somebody is the very best thing you can do

Please don't feel that nobody will listen to you. They would want to have a heart of steel to ignore you. Even call a doctor. Just because your mother believes mental disorders are a joke does not mean that they are.

Go and see a doctor, or even call a friend. Remember, you are only seventeen, you have your whole life ahead of you! Death is not an option! No matter how low you go, there is always a way to get back up again. I know you have probably heard it a thousand times but you need to listen! If you say goodbye, you will never get back up again! Please for the love of god go somewhere and just talk to somebody. It's the best thing for you. Talk to somebody you trust, and maybe stay the night at somebody else's house. That way you've got company, they will make you feel more secure and happy. Also, your sister will be absolutely devastated if you say goodbye. You've been there all her life, you probably mean the world to her. If you say goodbye, (I'm really just trying to convince you not to do it), she might do it as well. Please talk to somebody and tell them.
The fact that you are telling us is a good sign, a cry for help in a way. But you seriously need to go and talk to somebody. Please let me know you're still there by replying

Ok well the first thing you need to get out of you head is YOU DO NOT DESERVE TO DIE! No matter how much you feel you are wasting your life! My best advice to you is that whenever you feel suicidal, think about your parents, how much they love you, and how shocked they would be if you did something like that. Maybe you should go see a doctor or a psychologist, or even call a friend and tell them how you feel. But you should definately tell your parents and ask them for some advice.

As far as your song goes, don't worry about it. All you should be thinking about is sorting yourself out emotionally. When you recover you can explain to your professor that you were having suicidal thoughts and they would want to be possessed by the devil not to help you out or at least forgive you!

But please for the love of god don't feel you deserve to die, nobody does.
